title: The North Wind and the Sun
source: Aesop's Fables (public domain), gently retold for bedtime

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Once upon a time, high above the hills and the meadows, the North Wind and the Sun shared the big blue sky.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One day, they began to argue about which of them was the strongest.

lines.speaker: wind
lines.speech: [boastful, booming] I am the strongest! When I blow, the trees bend, and the waves roar!
lines.text: I am the strongest! When I blow, the trees bend, and the waves roar!

lines.speaker: sun
lines.speech: [calm, warm, gently amused] Perhaps. But let us find out.
lines.text: Perhaps. But let us find out.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Just then, they saw a traveller walking along the winding road below, wrapped in a warm red coat.

lines.speaker: sun
lines.speech: [kindly] Whoever can make that traveller take off his coat, is the strongest.
lines.text: Whoever can make that traveller take off his coat, is the strongest.

lines.speaker: wind
lines.speech: [laughs, confident] Ha! That will be easy. Watch me!
lines.text: Ha! That will be easy. Watch me!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So the North Wind took a deep breath, and blew. Whoosh!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The leaves went spinning. The grass bowed low. And the traveller's hat nearly flew away!

lines.speaker: traveller
lines.speech: [surprised, holding on] Oh my! What a chilly wind!
lines.text: Oh my! What a chilly wind!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So the Wind blew harder. And harder. But the harder he blew, the tighter the traveller wrapped his coat around him.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At last, the North Wind was all out of breath. He puffed, and he huffed, and then he gave up.

lines.speaker: sun
lines.text: Now, it is my turn.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Sun came out from behind the clouds, and began to shine. Softly at first, and then warmer, and warmer.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The flowers opened their petals. The bees began to hum. And the butterflies came out to dance.

lines.speaker: traveller
lines.speech: [relieved, happy, a little sigh] Ahh... what a lovely warm day it has become.
lines.text: Ahh... what a lovely warm day it has become.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The traveller unbuttoned his coat. And then, he took it off, and laid it on the grass.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He sat down to rest in the cool shade of an apple tree, and listened to the birds singing.

lines.speaker: wind
lines.speech: [softly, humbly] You did it, Sun. And you didn't even have to try hard at all.
lines.text: You did it, Sun. And you didn't even have to try hard at all.

lines.speaker: sun
lines.speech: [warm, wise] Sometimes, my friend, a little kindness and warmth can do what all the force in the world cannot.
lines.text: Sometimes, my friend, a little kindness and warmth can do what all the force in the world cannot.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And so, the Wind became a gentle breeze, softly rocking the leaves of the apple tree.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Sun sank slowly down behind the hills, painting the sky pink and gold. And under the tree, the traveller fell fast asleep.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the moon rose, round and silver, and the first stars began to twinkle.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Goodnight, little one. Sweet dreams.
